Bila Tserkva Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Kyivs'ka oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This record likely duplicates an entry already documented for Bila Tserkva elsewhere in this collection, sharing the same location and history — flagged here rather than treated as an entirely distinct site. This is Bila Tserkva's Old Jewish cemetery, founded in the 18th century and demolished during WWII; it first appears on a Russian topographic map from the mid-19th century. The Military Prosecutor's Office of the Bila Tserkva Garrison was built on the majority of the site, though fragments remain scattered around, most likely originating from matzevot that once stood near an ohel in the cemetery's southeastern section.
